name: judge
when: Judging a query group by group.

steps.title: Your queries
steps.text: Jump to any of your queries. They come in your own order; pilot queries come first.

steps.title: Every group at a glance
steps.text: Jump to any group; the number is how many images it holds.

steps.title: Groups of similar images
steps.text: Images that look alike are grouped, so one decision often covers many of them.

steps.title: Label a whole group
steps.text: One click gives every image in the group this label. Images you labelled on their own keep their label.

steps.title: Mixed group?
steps.text: Split it in two and label each half.

steps.title: Fold a group
steps.text: Hides or shows the images of this group.

steps.title: Judge one by one
steps.text: Below the groups: images unlike any other, judged on their own with the buttons under each.

steps.title: Collapse judged
steps.text: Folds every fully judged group at once; switch it off to unfold them again.

steps.title: Undo split
steps.text: Merges back the last group you split.
